packageRules.description: Keep the OpenVINO export stack together
Track CPU Torch packages together and require compatibility review
Qwen package updates can change the custom generation contract
OpenVINO 2026.2.1 and NNCF 3.2.0 require NumPy below 2.5

transformers is pinned to the version qwen-tts==0.1.1 was tested against; our OV export wrappers depend on specific internals (DynamicLayer, create_causal_mask). Re-enable when qwen-tts bumps its compatibility baseline. matchManagers intentionally omitted so the rule fires regardless of which manager detects the package (pep621, uv, custom.regex, etc.).

Pin Python to 3.13.x. The blocker for 3.14 is faster-whisper — users report install failures on 3.14 (no wheels/classifiers yet). Everything else in the stack already supports 3.14 (torch 2.13, pocket-tts 2.1, audioop-lts 0.2.2+). To lift this gate: watch https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper/issues/1404 and bump allowedVersions to >=3.13,<3.15 once faster-whisper ships 3.14 wheels. Covers requires-python in pyproject.toml, the Dockerfile FROM image, and python-version in CI workflows.
